analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 89,725) above SMA5 (KRW 88,437), below SMA20 (KRW 102,871) and SMA50 (KRW 104,862): attempting short-term rebound but below mid-term trend.
· Significantly below SMA100 (KRW 113,980) and SMA200 (KRW 99,667): confirming strong mid-to-long-term downtrend.
· 52-week position at 36.8% + current price range approaching historical low levels.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 30.3 → 33.3 (entering oversold): attempting to exit extreme oversold, weak directional momentum.
· MACD histogram -1788.6755 → -2048.7272 (worsening): signal of continued bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position near the lower band (KRW 83,473): approaching lower band phase.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support at KRW 82,710: based on Pivot S1 (KRW 78,472) and 52-week low (KRW 53,135).
· Swing resistance at KRW 95,720: based on Pivot PP (KRW 96,553) and 5-day high (KRW 91,390).
· 5-day high KRW 91,390, 20-day high KRW 114,635: Lower High pattern confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio 0.84: reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Rebound attempt within a downtrend: low confidence in trend reversal due to subdued volume and worsening MACD. Maintain wait-and-see.
